metric_setup_specification.evaluation_unit: Full 3D patient volume (never 2D slice-wise or random patch-wise)

target_subregions.channel_1_WT: Whole Tumor = NCR (label 1) U ED (label 2) U ET (label 4)

primary_metrics.Dice: 2 * |P n G| / (|P| + |G|), range [0, 1], higher is better
primary_metrics.HD95_mm: max(P95(d(dP -> dG)), P95(d(dG -> dP))) in mm at spacing [1.0, 1.0, 1.0], lower is better

secondary_metrics.IoU_Jaccard: |P n G| / |P u G|, range [0, 1], higher is better
secondary_metrics.Sensitivity_Recall: TP / (TP + FN), range [0, 1], higher is better
secondary_metrics.Precision_PPV: TP / (TP + FP), range [0, 1], higher is better

empty_region_convention.both_empty (|P|==0 and |G|==0): Dice=1.0, IoU=1.0, Sensitivity=1.0, Precision=1.0, HD95=0.0 mm
empty_region_convention.single_empty (|P|==0 xor |G|==0): Dice=0.0, IoU=0.0, HD95=373.13 mm (SRI24 volume diagonal penalty)

aggregation_and_selection.step_1: Compute volumetric metric per patient n and sub-region c in {TC, WT, ET}
aggregation_and_selection.step_2: Macro-average across patients: Metric_c = (1/N) * sum_n Metric(n, c)
aggregation_and_selection.step_3: Macro-average across 3 regions: Mean_Metric = (Metric_TC + Metric_WT + Metric_ET) / 3
